thumbnails.concept_ko: 차오현 한푸 매출 2조 7천억 vs 한국 한복 제조업 전체 1,420억 = 약 19배. 이 낙차 자체가 대본의 뼈대이므로 '규모 차이가 곧 메시지'인 스케일 대비를 골랐다. 우측은 끝이 안 보이는 한푸 창고, 좌측은 유리돔 속 저고리 단 한 벌. 표정은 '돈은 다 셌는데 손이 옷에 닿지 못한' 계산형 미소로, 앵커의 절망 표정과 감정 방향을 반대로 뒀다.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the lower two-fifths of this image is one clean continuous surface — plain polished concrete floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every subject, character, object, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper three-fifths above it. photorealistic advertising composite, intense neon glow lighting, emissive brand colors spilling onto surrounding surfaces, extreme color contrast, the upper three-fifths densely packed with elements, exaggerated wide-angle perspective, hyper-saturated and eye-catching. Across the right two-thirds of the upper area stands a colossal Chinese garment mega-warehouse: hundreds of steel racks crammed with identical mass-produced Chinese hanfu robes in plastic wrap, receding into a violent wide-angle vanishing point, every rack edge lined with emissive magenta neon that spills magenta light across the garments and the stacked shipping cartons, with a clean crisp Chinese national flag (red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars) hanging high on the far wall. In the left foreground, absurdly tiny by comparison, one single Korean hanbok jeogori jacket floats inside a small glass display dome, its gold-embroidered goreum ribbon catching a hard cyan rim light and a warm gold inner glow so it reads as the one precious object in the frame. Filling the right foreground chest-up is a good-looking middle-aged Chinese hanfu wholesaler in a dark suit with a warm likeable face, brightly lit by studio light: eyes narrowed to confident slits but the pupils slid sideways toward the little hanbok, only the left corner of his mouth pulled up so a single cheek puffs, lower lip lightly bitten, one hand holding a thick fan of banknotes beside his jaw while the other hand reaches palm-up toward the hanbok with the fingertips stopping dead in mid-air. Deep indigo background, magenta versus cyan two-colour dominance, absolutely no fire, no flames, no embers and no smoke anywhere. no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark

thumbnails.concept_ko: 2025년 10월 국내 플랫폼 한푸 '한복' 등록, 2025년 12월 아마존 'Hanbok' 표기 판매, 샤오미 배경화면 스토어의 한복 중국문화 분류, 바이두 백과의 '조선족 복식' 기술 — 대본이 다루는 최전선이 상품 페이지라는 걸 보여주려면 사건의 무대를 그대로 보여주는 현장 장면이 맞다. 표정은 1번과 달리 '들켰는데도 태연한' 뻔뻔함으로 갈랐다.

Occupying the right third chest-up is a good-looking middle-aged Chinese online seller in a black polo shirt with a warm likeable face: one eyebrow hitched high while the other stays flat, eyes locked on the screen without blinking, both mouth corners pulled wide in a grin that never reaches the eyes, the nose bridge wrinkled, one index finger tapping the glass of the monitor and the other hand casually flipping a thin stack of banknotes. thumbnails.concept_ko: 확정 제목 '찍어내고도 못 가진'을 가장 직역한 그림. 돈은 물리적으로 쏟아지는데 옷은 유리 너머에 있고 손바닥이 유리에 눌려 자국만 남는다. 시선을 한 지점에 몰아야 소유 실패가 0.3초에 읽히므로 중앙 집중을 골랐다. 표정은 땀도 절망도 없이 '여유롭지만 못 가진' 상태로, 앵커의 이마 땀·관자놀이 짚기와 정면 대비된다.

Dead centre of the upper frame stands a thick armoured glass vitrine lit from within by cyan and gold light, and inside it hovers one Korean hanbok jeogori jacket with a gold-embroidered goreum ribbon streaming upward, untouched and immaculate. Around the vitrine the room is drowning in money: industrial banknote-printing presses on both sides spit continuous ribbons of freshly cut currency that pile into bricks and avalanche past the glass without ever getting in, all of it washed in emissive magenta neon that spills onto the machinery and the ceiling. Pressed against the right face of the glass, chest-up and shot slightly from the side, is a good-looking middle-aged Chinese hanfu wholesaler in a dark suit with a warm likeable face: eyelids lowered to half-mast, gaze fixed on the jacket beyond the glass, mouth clamped sideways so one cheek is being chewed from inside, brow smooth and dry with no sweat at all, one open palm flattened hard on the glass leaving a smeared handprint while the other hand still grips a fan of banknotes. thumbnails.concept_ko: 제목이 감춘 '이 매출'을 액수 없이 시각화하는 장. 매출 곡선은 끝까지 올라가는데 정점에서 손이 허공에 멈춘다 — 수치 상승과 소유 실패를 한 화면에 붙였다. 수치 변화가 핵심이므로 그래프·화살표 구도. 숫자는 은닉해야 하므로 눈금과 라벨을 전부 제거했다. 표정은 3번의 체념 섞인 여유와 달리 '어이없다는 듯 입을 옆으로 늘인' 반응으로 갈랐다.

Standing on the highest banknote step at the right, waist-up in the upper third, is a good-looking middle-aged Chinese hanfu wholesaler in a dark suit with a warm likeable face brightly lit by a hard key light: one eyebrow shot up high, eyes half-lidded and cutting sideways at the jacket, lips stretched long and flat to one side in a wry hum, shoulders hitched into a shrug, one hand still fanning banknotes and the other stretched toward the jacket with the fingers curling shut on empty air. [차별화 5개 전부 적용] ① 피사체: 대한민국 여권 → 금박 자수 한복 저고리, 시진핑 → 지폐 다발을 든 차오현 한푸 도매상 ② 색: 네이비+화염 오렌지 → 딥 인디고+마젠타·시안, 화염 전면 제거 ③ 시점: 정면 아이레벨 → 좌측 오브젝트를 아래에서 올려다보는 로우앵글 ④ 강조 요소: 국기 방사형 크랙+지도 화염 → 가격표 태그와 바코드 스티커가 옷 위에 붙어 흘러내림 ⑤ 감정 방향: 절망(관자놀이 짚고 땀) → 능청스러운 계산.

His expression carries the whole frame: eyes narrowed into a sly smile but the pupils rolled left toward the hanbok, only one corner of the mouth lifted so a single cheek balloons, lower lip caught between the teeth, one hand holding a thick fan of banknotes up beside his jaw and the other hand reaching palm-up toward the jacket with the fingertips frozen in mid-air, brow completely dry. The upper right corner above his head is left as clean empty dark space.
